title: Summer Festival 2026 — save the date
message: The Yammouneh Summer Festival returns this August with headline singers, dabke nights, and the kids' village. Program announcement coming soon.

title: Volunteers needed: lake reforestation day
message: Join us in September to plant native cedars and junipers around Yammouneh Lake. Tools, transport from the village square, and lunch provided.

title: New spring-trail maps available
message: Updated hiking maps covering 12 of the 84 springs are now available at the visitor point — ask our team or request them by email.
